title: Hotspots Summary
description: Top-5 function summary built by hotspots-cloud's build_summary() (scripts/pipeline/core.py) from a `hotspots analyze --mode snapshot --explain-patterns` run. This is a derived artifact, not the raw CLI output -- served at each post's report_json URL on reports.hotspots.dev. Keep this file in sync with build_summary() whenever it changes; it was found drifted (lrs/quadrant/touches_30d/days_since_changed documented but never emitted, risk_tier emitted but undocumented, quadrant enum using stale values) and corrected 2026-10-10.

sha.description: Full 40-character git commit SHA that was analyzed

analyzed_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the analysis ran

hotspots_version.description: Version of the hotspots CLI that produced this snapshot

clone_depth.description: Git clone depth used — affects how far back commit history is considered when computing activity scores. Null if not recorded for this run.

hybrid_touch_threshold.description: Function-count threshold above which hybrid touch-metric mode was used. Null if not recorded for this run.

total_functions.description: Total functions analyzed in this snapshot

by_band.description: Function count per risk band (e.g. critical/high/moderate/low)

top_risk.description: Activity-weighted risk score of the highest-ranked function in this snapshot

top.description: Top functions ranked by activity-weighted risk, descending. Typically 5 entries.

function.description: Function name. '<anonymous>' for arrow functions or unnamed expressions.

file.description: File path relative to the repo root

risk.description: Activity-weighted risk score for this function (complexity × recent commit activity).

risk_tier.description: Risk band label for this function (e.g. critical/high/moderate/low).

patterns.description: Antipattern labels detected on this function. Empty array if none.

pattern_counts.description: Aggregate count of each antipattern label across all top functions

top_patterns.description: Antipattern labels sorted by frequency (most common first)
